description: Authored fresh challenge fixture frozen before scoring; not independently collected. Related-memory rows deliberately distinguish retrieval relevance from support for the requested fact. No inference answers are evaluated here.

records.body: Mira keeps the soldering iron in the locked orange cabinet in the garage.
Leonie reconciles travel reimbursements on the last Thursday of each month.
The Juniper public launch was postponed until 18 September because accessibility testing is unfinished.
Visitors using wheelchairs should enter the studio through the courtyard ramp, not the front steps.
For urgent laboratory equipment faults, telephone technician Arun on extension 204.
During winter the greenhouse succulents are watered once every three weeks.
Celia cannot eat sesame; meals for her must exclude tahini and sesame oil.
The upstairs label printer jams unless the glossy side of the roll faces downward.
The encrypted design archive is copied to the external silver SSD every Friday before shutdown.
Tomas mentors new volunteers during their first two Saturday shifts at the repair cafe.
The ceramics workshop lease expires on 30 November; renewal discussions must start in August.
The field recorder takes two rechargeable AA cells; spare batteries are in the microphone pouch.
Send supplier invoices as PDF attachments to Priya, who assigns each one a purchase-order number.
The neighbourhood seed exchange meets in the library basement at 10:30 on the first Sunday.
Use water-based varnish on the toy shelves because solvent fumes trigger Daniel's headaches.
After the rear tyre punctured, Noor left the folding bicycle at Elm Street Cycles for collection on Tuesday.
The guest wireless password is printed inside the reception drawer; do not read it aloud in the waiting room.
Keep the tomato seedlings indoors until overnight temperatures remain above ten degrees Celsius.
Refunds for the cancelled weaving class will be issued to the original payment cards within seven working days.
Fragile glass samples go in foam-lined boxes with upright arrows on every side.
The shared study room is reserved for silent work until noon; group discussions move to the kitchen.
Calibrate the digital scale with the sealed 100-gram reference weight before weighing pigments.
Our museum visit booking is under the surname Iqbal, and the confirmation code is RIVER-682.
For the oral-history recordings, Malika translates spoken Arabic and Joana checks the English subtitles.
Model-authored note; not independently verified: Before comparing monthly accounts, open the original ledger and check its reporting period.
